HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

   B. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   C. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.

3. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   B. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

9. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   B. Destroying road signs
